text:
ash: Quick question about /v2/infer error semantics — we need to finalize before canary.

nia: what's the specific concern?

ash: two things: 1) validation errors vs transient infra. i.e., should we return 400 vs 422? 2) Add a machine-readable retry hint so SDKs can auto-retry safely.

samuel: for (1) we usually use 400 for malformed requests (missing required fields, bad JSON), 422 for well-formed but semantically invalid (e.g., prompt too long, invalid model param). 5xx for infra.

lina: agree. also we should include `retryable:true` in body for 5xx-like transients and `retry_after` (seconds) for 429/503. example:
```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "rate_limit",
    "message": "Too many requests",
    "retryable": true,
    "retry_after": 30
  }
}
```

ash: nice. for backward compat: v1 SDKs expect 400/429/500 - they don't inspect `retryable`. can we keep status codes standard and add header `x-redwood-retryable: 1`? that way old clients still react to status, new ones use header+body.

nia: header sounds fine. but avoid `x-` deprecated? we do `Retryable: 1`? Ops prefers namespaced `x-redwood-retryable` for clarity.

samuel: also think about idempotency for generation endpoints. if a client retries a request we should support `Idempotency-Key` for safe retries.

lina: yep. propose doc snippet for the contract: list of status code meanings. keep it brief.

ash: putting draft contract below — pls 👀 and thumbs up if ok, or comment differences.

ash: ```
# Error contract v2 (summary)
# 400 Bad Request -> malformed JSON or missing required top-level fields
# 422 Unprocessable Entity -> semantic validation (invalid model param, prompt too long)
# 401 Unauthorized -> invalid API key
# 403 Forbidden -> customer-level restrictions
# 404 Not Found -> resource unknown
# 409 Conflict -> idempotency key conflict
# 429 Too Many Requests -> rate limit (include retry_after header and body.retryable=true)
# 503 Service Unavailable -> transient infra (body.retryable=true, x-redwood-retryable: 1)
# 500 Internal Server Error -> unexpected server error (retryable=false by default)

# Response body additions:
# - `error.code` (string), `error.message` (string)
# - `error.retryable` (bool), `error.retry_after` (secs, optional)
# - header `x-redwood-retryable: 1|0`
# - support `Idempotency-Key` for safe retries on POST /v2/infer
```

nia: looks good. small ask: for 500 should we sometimes mark retryable=true if infra flagged? might be confusing unless we have internal mapping.

samuel: we can set `retryable` per-error instance. 500 default false but monitoring/ops can flip depending on cause.

lina: agree. add a line that SDK should only auto-retry if status is 429/503 or error.retryable===true and idempotency behavior safe.

ash: ok. can someone PR this into open api spec and ping me? need it in this week's release notes.

samuel: I'll open PR with schema examples + tests. will add header and body fields.

lina: pinging @deploy-bot to add feature flag for canary rollout on /v2 for 10%.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: canary rollout for /v2 error-contract on staging -> prod (10%). ETA 2026-03-18 02:00 UTC :rocket:

ash: thanks. Samuel, LMK when PR is up so I can review in morning.

samuel: PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/842 — includes tests and spec. assign @ash @lina

ash: reviewing now, will leave comments. small note: add example for client SDK pseudo-code showing retry backoff and inspecting `x-redwood-retryable`.

lina: LGTM otherwise. :thumbsup:

ash: cool. closing thread after PR merged. thx everyone.
